title: ClawKeeper: Comprehensive Safety Protection for OpenClaw Agents Through Skills, Plugins, and Watchers
task: Security protection for OpenClaw autonomous agents
key_results: Three-layer protection framework (skills, plugins, watchers) effectively prevents data leakage, privilege escalation, and malicious skill execution across diverse threat scenarios
comments: Addresses critical gap in agent security by introducing decoupled watcher-based middleware paradigm that could generalize beyond OpenClaw.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-layer protection is superior to fragmented security measures
hypotheses.result: Confirmed through comprehensive evaluation across threat scenarios

title: MiroEval: Benchmarking Multimodal Deep Research Agents in Process and Outcome
task: Benchmarking multimodal deep research agents on process and outcome
key_results: Process quality predicts outcome better than output-level metrics alone; multimodal tasks cause 3-10 point performance drop; MiroThinker-H1 achieves highest balanced performance
comments: Novel process-centric evaluation dimension is valuable, though benchmark limited to 100 tasks and may need more diversity in real-world complexity.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Process quality correlates with outcome quality
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; process serves as reliable performance predictor

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multimodal tasks are harder than text-only
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 3-10 point performance degradation observed

title: Terminal Agents Suffice for Enterprise Automation
task: Enterprise task automation via terminal agents
key_results: Simple terminal agents with API access match or outperform complex tool-augmented and web agent architectures on diverse real-world systems
comments: Practical finding that challenges industry assumptions about necessary complexity; validates direct programmatic interfaces over graphical abstraction layers.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Complex agentic architectures (MCP, web agents) are necessary for enterprise automation
hypotheses.result: Rejected; simple terminal agents suffice and often outperform

title: ViGoR-Bench: How Far Are Visual Generative Models From Zero-Shot Visual Reasoners?
task: Evaluating visual generative models on reasoning-centric tasks
key_results: State-of-the-art systems harbor significant reasoning deficits; cross-modal evaluation reveals logical failures despite visual fidelity in AIGC models
comments: Well-motivated critique that existing metrics miss logical reasoning gaps; dual-track evaluation of processes and results is methodologically sound.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Modern AIGC models possess robust physical and causal reasoning capabilities
hypotheses.result: Rejected; significant reasoning deficits exposed across state-of-the-art systems

title: Vision2Web: A Hierarchical Benchmark for Visual Website Development with Agent Verification
task: Hierarchical visual website development evaluation
key_results: 193 tasks across 16 categories; substantial performance gaps at all levels; state-of-the-art models achieve ~60% on static UI-to-code but struggle on full-stack development
comments: Comprehensive hierarchical structure (static→interactive→full-stack) well-designed; GUI+VLM verification paradigm is practical and extensible.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Visual LLMs can effectively handle end-to-end website development
hypotheses.result: Partially rejected; full-stack development remains substantially harder than static UI generation

title: QuitoBench: A High-Quality Open Time Series Forecasting Benchmark
task: High-quality time series forecasting benchmarking
key_results: Context-length crossover: deep learning leads at short context (L=96), foundation models at long context (L≥576); forecastability drives 3.64× MAE variation; scaling data beats scaling model size
comments: Regime-balanced approach (TSF properties vs. domain labels) is methodologically superior; cross-benchmark consistency strengthens findings.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Foundation models uniformly outperform deep learning at all context lengths
hypotheses.result: Rejected; crossover at intermediate context; DL competitive at 59× fewer parameters

hypotheses.hypothesis: Scaling model parameters improves forecasting more than data
hypotheses.result: Rejected; data scaling provides substantially greater benefit

title: Reasoning Shift: How Context Silently Shortens LLM Reasoning
task: Understanding reasoning robustness under context variation
key_results: Reasoning traces shorten up to 50% under different context conditions; compression correlates with reduced self-verification; performance impact on hard tasks unexplored
comments: Important robustness concern for reasoning models; finding suggests potential failure modes in production settings with variable context.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Reasoning models produce consistent trace lengths regardless of context
hypotheses.result: Rejected; up to 50% compression observed under different context conditions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Context-induced compression preserves performance on all tasks
hypotheses.result: Partially supported; performance unaffected on straightforward problems but unclear on hard tasks

title: HippoCamp: Benchmarking Contextual Agents on Personal Computers
task: Evaluating agents on multimodal personal file management
key_results: 48.3% accuracy on user profiling; multimodal perception and evidence grounding are primary bottlenecks; 42.4GB real-world file system benchmark with 2K+ files
comments: User-centric realistic setting is valuable; the 46.1K annotated trajectories enable fine-grained failure diagnosis unavailable in other benchmarks.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Advanced MLLMs excel at cross-modal reasoning in dense personal file systems
hypotheses.result: Rejected; significant performance gap with major bottlenecks identified

title: PerceptionComp: A Video Benchmark for Complex Perception-Centric Reasoning
task: Complex long-horizon perception-centric video reasoning
key_results: 1,114 questions require multiple temporally separated visual evidence; human accuracy drops to 18.97% without rewatching; best MLLM (Gemini-3-Flash) reaches 45.96%
comments: Challenging benchmark design requiring compositional logic across temporal gaps; open-source models substantially worse (below 40%) suggests frontier model advantage.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Perception-centric long-horizon reasoning is a solved problem
hypotheses.result: Rejected; major performance gap and evidence that it remains a bottleneck

title: Universal YOCO for Efficient Depth Scaling
task: Efficient depth scaling via recursive computation architecture
key_results: Universal YOCO maintains constant global KV cache with linear pre-filling; favorable capability-efficiency tradeoff vs. standard YOCO or recursion alone; competitive on general and long-context benchmarks
comments: Clever architectural combination (YOCO decoder + recursion) addresses real inference bottleneck; practical for long-context and test-time scaling applications.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Parameter sharing via recursion can enhance representational depth without proportional overhead
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; partial recursion improves scaling with limited efficiency cost

title: GaussianGPT: Towards Autoregressive 3D Gaussian Scene Generation
task: Autoregressive 3D Gaussian scene generation
key_results: Fully autoregressive transformer-based approach enables step-by-step 3D scene construction; supports completion, outpainting, temperature-controlled sampling; compatible with neural rendering pipelines
comments: Novel autoregressive formulation contrasts with dominant diffusion paradigm; compositional inductive biases of autoregressive modeling are well-motivated for 3D generation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Diffusion is necessary for high-quality 3D scene generation
hypotheses.result: Rejected; autoregressive alternative viable with complementary advantages

title: Embarrassingly Simple Self-Distillation Improves Code Generation
task: Self-distillation for code generation improvement
key_results: Simple self-distillation (SSD) improves Qwen3-30B from 42.4% to 55.3% pass@1; gains concentrate on harder problems; generalizes across Qwen/Llama at 4B-30B scale
comments: Elegant method requiring only temperature/truncation tuning and SFT; attributing gains to precision-exploration trade-off is insightful and well-supported.

hypotheses.hypothesis: LLMs cannot improve at code generation without external feedback or teacher models
hypotheses.result: Rejected; simple self-distillation on raw outputs suffices

hypotheses.hypothesis: SSD gains stem from suppressing distractor tails while preserving exploration diversity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed through token distribution analysis

title: Paper Reconstruction Evaluation: Evaluating Presentation and Hallucination in AI-written Papers
task: Evaluating presentation quality and hallucinations in AI-written papers
key_results: Clear trade-off between presentation and hallucination: ClaudeCode higher quality but 10+ hallucinations/paper; Codex fewer hallucinations but lower presentation; 51 papers from 2025+ venues
comments: First systematic framework for AI paper writing evaluation; orthogonal dimensions (Presentation/Hallucination) are well-motivated but hallucination detection may miss subtle errors.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Model advances uniformly improve AI-written paper quality
hypotheses.result: Rejected; trade-off between presentation and hallucination accuracy observed

title: Proactive Agent Research Environment: Simulating Active Users to Evaluate Proactive Assistants
task: Evaluating proactive agents in stateful digital environments
key_results: 143 diverse tasks spanning communication, productivity, scheduling; tests context observation, goal inference, intervention timing, multi-app orchestration; enables active user simulation via FSM modeling
comments: FSM-based application modeling improves on flat API abstractions; 143 tasks seem moderate in scale but diverse scope is valuable for comprehensive evaluation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Flat tool APIs adequately model digital environment interactions
hypotheses.result: Rejected; FSM with stateful navigation required for realistic simulation

title: Think, Act, Build: An Agentic Framework with Vision Language Models for Zero-Shot 3D Visual Grounding
task: Zero-shot 3D visual grounding via 2D VLM agent framework
key_results: Think-Act-Build framework outperforms supervised baselines; decouples 2D VLM semantics from 3D geometry; Semantic-Anchored Geometric Expansion addresses multi-view coverage gaps
comments: Clever 2D-to-3D paradigm avoids reliance on 3D point clouds; manual benchmark corrections improve reliability but generalization to uncurated data unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: 3D visual grounding requires preprocessed 3D point cloud processing
hypotheses.result: Rejected; 2D-to-3D reconstruction via VLM agent suffices and surpasses supervised approaches

title: A Survey of On-Policy Distillation for Large Language Models
task: Comprehensive survey of on-policy distillation for LLMs
key_results: Unified f-divergence framework over on-policy samples; three orthogonal dimensions (feedback signal, teacher access, loss granularity); identifies scaling laws and agent-level distillation as open problems
comments: Survey provides valuable conceptual unification across fragmented OPD literature; identifies exposure bias as core motivation but mechanistic understanding of student learning dynamics remains limited.

hypotheses.hypothesis: On-policy distillation addresses exposure bias in LLM training
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via unified theoretical framework and empirical methods

title: UniMixer: A Unified Architecture for Scaling Laws in Recommendation Systems
task: Unified scaling architecture for recommendation systems
key_results: UniMixer bridges attention-based, TokenMixer, and factorization-machine methods; UniMixing-Lite compresses parameters/FLOPs while improving performance; online experiments validate scaling benefits
comments: Unifying theoretical framework is valuable; removal of head-count constraint over TokenMizer is practical but scalability limits vs. foundation models unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Attention, TokenMixer, and factorization methods are fundamentally incompatible
hypotheses.result: Rejected; unified parameterized framework subsumes all three

title: MMaDA-VLA: Large Diffusion Vision-Language-Action Model with Unified Multi-Modal Instruction and Generation
task: Diffusion-based vision-language-action model for robot control
key_results: 98.0% average success on LIBERO; 4.78 average length on CALVIN; unified multi-modal discrete diffusion enables parallel goal and action generation without auxiliary world models
comments: Native diffusion VLA avoids hierarchical/autoregressive overhead; parallel generation is elegant but comparison with simpler alternatives (e.g., autoregressive baselines) would strengthen claims.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Discrete diffusion with masked denoising improves long-horizon robot control consistency
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via state-of-the-art performance on simulation and real tasks

title: Revision or Re-Solving? Decomposing Second-Pass Gains in Multi-LLM Pipelines
task: Decomposing multi-LLM revision pipeline gains
key_results: Three additive components (re-solving, scaffold, content) explain gains; on MCQ stronger-model direct routing often beats revision; on code tasks weak drafts provide structural scaffolding despite semantic issues
comments: Controlled decomposition experiment design is rigorous; findings challenge blanket revision assumptions but task-dependent nature may limit generalization.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-LLM revision gains uniformly stem from error correction
hypotheses.result: Rejected; gains decompose into re-solving, scaffold, and content contributions varying by task

title: Benchmarking and Mechanistic Analysis of Vision-Language Models for Cross-Depiction Assembly Instruction Alignment
task: Evaluating VLMs on assembly instruction alignment across visual modalities
key_results: 1,623 questions across 6 task types; architecture family predicts alignment accuracy better than parameter count; diagrams and video occupy disjoint ViT subspaces; text shifts models toward text-driven reasoning
comments: IKEA-Bench construction from real products is practical; mechanistic analysis revealing disjoint subspaces is insightful but sample size (29 products) may limit generalization.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Parameter scale determines cross-depiction alignment robustness
hypotheses.result: Rejected; architecture family is stronger predictor than model size

hypotheses.hypothesis: Text assists diagram-to-video alignment
hypotheses.result: Rejected; text degrades alignment by shifting toward text-driven reasoning

title: Understand and Accelerate Memory Processing Pipeline for Disaggregated LLM Inference
task: Accelerating memory processing in disaggregated LLM inference
key_results: 22%-97% memory processing overhead identified; heterogeneous GPU-FPGA system achieves 1.04-2.2× speedup and 1.11-4.7× energy reduction vs. GPU baseline; unified four-step pipeline framework
comments: Systematic profiling reveals heterogeneity opportunity; FPGA offloading of sparse/irregular operations is practical but adoption barriers (specialized hardware, deployment complexity) remain.

model_io.model: LLM Inference (sparse attention, RAG, compressed memory)

hypotheses.hypothesis: GPU monolithic processing is optimal for memory-bounded operations
hypotheses.result: Rejected; FPGA heterogeneous acceleration achieves substantial speedup and energy gains

title: MemRerank: Preference Memory for Personalized Product Reranking
task: Preference memory extraction for personalized product reranking
key_results: MemRerank distills purchase history into concise query-independent signals; +10.61 absolute points in 1-in-5 accuracy; RL-trained memory extractor outperforms baselines on downstream reranking
comments: Practical framework for e-commerce personalization; RL supervision on reranking performance is well-motivated but evaluation limited to 1-in-5 selection task.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Raw purchase history effectively guides LLM-based product reranking
hypotheses.result: Rejected; explicit preference memory substantially improves performance

title: AI Generalisation Gap In Comorbid Sleep Disorder Staging
task: Generalization of deep learning sleep staging to clinical populations
key_results: Poor cross-domain performance between healthy and ischemic stroke cohorts; Grad-CAM reveals model focuses on physiologically uninformative regions in patient data; iSLEEPS dataset with ischemic stroke annotations
comments: Important clinical validation finding; disease-specific models required before deployment but sample-size concerns and generalization to other stroke types unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Deep learning models trained on healthy EEG generalize to clinical populations
hypotheses.result: Rejected; significant generalization gap with attention on non-physiological features

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sleep architecture is consistent across healthy and diseased cohorts
hypotheses.result: Rejected; statistical/computational analysis reveals significant differences

title: Linking multipoint folding and stability with functional regulation in the mitochondrial transmembrane β-barrel Sam50
task: Characterize Sam50 folding pathways and link folding dynamics to functional regulation in β-barrel assembly
key_results: Sam50 folds through parallel pathways with ≥2 transition states; folding nucleus at N-terminus, C-terminal frustrated folding kinetically traps structure; destabilizing hotspots correlate with gating function
comments: Integration of single-molecule electrophysiology with 165 mutational variants provides unprecedented per-residue mechanistic detail, though ensemble stability measurements may obscure heterogeneous pathways.

hypotheses.hypothesis: POlypeptide-TRansport Associated domain is essential for function
hypotheses.result: Rejected; domain is dispensable for Sam50 function

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dynamic structure and frustrated folding provide functional advantage
hypotheses.result: Supported; destabilizing hotspots regulate both folding kinetics and gating behavior

title: Cardiac myofibril networks induce shear stress
task: Quantify how myofibril network geometry affects cardiac cell force generation and shear stress distribution
key_results: Myofibrils deviate locally up to 30° from contraction axis (SD=6.56°); network organization generates distinct shear stresses and internal rotation absent in uniaxial models
comments: Finite element modeling based on deep learning segmentation is rigorous, but validation against experimental force measurements would strengthen mechanistic claims.

model_io.model: Non-linear finite element model of cardiomyocyte contraction
inputs: Z-disc orientations from deep learning segmentation
Myofibril geometry (mean deviation 0.03°, local deviation up to 30°)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Myofibril network anisotropy modulates force generation differently than uniaxial arrays
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; anisotropic geometry generates spatial shear stress patterns with z-disc orientation correlation

title: Active assembly and non-reciprocal dynamics of elastic membranes
task: Demonstrate active self-assembly of elastic membranes via non-reciprocal coupling between actin fibres and microtubule-based active fluid
key_results: Chaotic active flows induce fibre collision and weaving into membrane-like elastic network; active membrane exhibits global limit cycles from non-reciprocal elasticity-nematicity coupling; hierarchical structures span nanometres to centimetres
comments: Elegant demonstration of non-equilibrium self-assembly bridging synthetic and living matter, though quantitative metrics (frequency of limit cycles, membrane elasticity values) are not specified in abstract.

model_io.model: Active cytoskeletal suspension (actin fibres + microtubule-based active fluid)
inputs: Non-thermal chaotic flows from microtubule motors

hypotheses.hypothesis: Autonomous chaotic flows can power hierarchical self-assembly into membrane structures
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; collision and weaving generate nanometre-to-centimetre hierarchy

hypotheses.hypothesis: Non-reciprocal membrane-fluid coupling induces sustained global oscillations
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; active membrane exhibits limit cycle behavior

title: A novel arc signal and motor power synchronization-based method for precise contact fault diagnosis of GIS disconnector
task: Develop precise fault diagnosis for GIS disconnectors using arc signal and motor power synchronization
key_results: Arc signal from Rogowski coil accurately identifies contact engagement/separation; adaptive wavelet packet decomposition enables detection of mechanical faults (refusal to close/open, insufficient overtravel)
comments: This is a power systems engineering application outside core biophysics scope; methodology is practical but lacks biological relevance to the present domain.

model_io.model: Arc signal processing and motor power analysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: Arc signal and motor power can be synchronized to diagnose GIS disconnector faults reliably
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; experimental validation demonstrates robustness for common mechanical faults

title: M6A-dependent upregulation of ZNF460 promotes epithelial-mesenchymal transition and metastasis of gastric cancer through a histone modification-mediated positive feedback loop
task: Characterize m6A-epitranscriptomic axis regulating EMT and gastric cancer metastasis
key_results: METTL16-mediated m6A methylation of ZNF460 mRNA promotes TGF-β-induced EMT; ZNF460/USP22/PHF8 complex upregulates SOX4 and enhances METTL16 transcription (positive feedback); elevated ZNF460+METTL16+SOX4 predicts poor prognosis
comments: Novel mechanistic integration of epitranscriptomics, epigenetics, and transcriptional regulation with strong clinical correlation; the positive feedback loop amplification dynamics and temporal kinetics during EMT warrant quantitative modeling.

hypotheses.hypothesis: m6A methylation of ZNF460 mRNA by METTL16 promotes TGF-β-induced EMT through ZNF460/USP22/PHF8-mediated SOX4 activation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; m6A-dependent ZNF460 upregulation drives EMT; histone modification complex enhances SOX4 and forms positive feedback with METTL16

title: PINK1 and STUB1 pathway orchestrates peroxisomal selective autophagy by PEX13 depletion
task: Identify ATM-PINK1-STUB1 signaling cascade regulating peroxisomal quality control via pexophagy
key_results: PINK1 is key regulator of PEX13-depletion-induced pexophagy; PINK1 phosphorylates STUB1 to enhance ubiquitination of ABCD3, recruiting SQSTM1; ATM activates PINK1 under peroxisomal stress
comments: Elegant identification of a stress-responsive quality control pathway with clear epistatic relationships, though functional validation of the pathway (e.g., blocking pexophagy and demonstrating disease consequences) would strengthen mechanistic claims.

model_io.model: siRNA screening; cells with peroxisomal impairment

hypotheses.hypothesis: ATM-PINK1-STUB1 cascade orchestrates peroxisomal selective autophagy in response to peroxisomal dysfunction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; PINK1 is essential regulator of PEX13-induced pexophagy; ATM activates PINK1 under stress

title: ATF3-dependent formation of inclusion bodies in polyQ-expressing human iPSC-derived neurons confers cellular protection
task: Determine protective vs. detrimental role of polyQ inclusion bodies in Huntington's disease
key_results: PolyQ inclusion bodies (IBs) confer significant cellular protection against stress; ATF3 knockout prevented IB formation and increased neuronal vulnerability
comments: Direct comparison of IB+ and IB- neurons provides compelling evidence for protective function, resolving a long-standing debate, though mechanistic basis of ATF3's role in IB formation needs further clarification.

model_io.model: iPSC-derived human neurons with polyQ expansion

hypotheses.hypothesis: PolyQ inclusion bodies are protective against polyQ-induced cellular stress
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; IB+ neurons show reduced cell death and stress vulnerability compared to IB- neurons

hypotheses.hypothesis: ATF3 is required for polyQ IB formation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; ATF3 knockout prevents IB formation and increases stress sensitivity

title: Stiff matrix-induced KRTAP2-3 expression suppresses ciliogenesis via actin tension-driven chromatin remodeling
task: Elucidate mechanotransduction pathway linking matrix stiffness to ciliogenesis suppression
key_results: Stiff matrix increases actin polarization, which promotes KRTAP2-3 expression via nuclear deformation and chromatin remodeling; KRTAP2-3 knockdown reverses ciliation inhibition
comments: Elegant integration of mechanobiology and epigenetics, though the specific role of KRTAP2-3 in ciliation remains functionally unclear beyond its expression correlation.

model_io.model: Cells cultured on soft vs. stiff matrix

hypotheses.hypothesis: Matrix stiffness suppresses ciliogenesis through actin-dependent nuclear deformation and KRTAP2-3 upregulation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; disrupting actin polarization or knocking down KRTAP2-3 restores ciliation on stiff matrix

title: Oxidative DNA damage drives apoptotic photoreceptor loss in NMNAT1-associated inherited retinal degeneration: a therapeutic opportunity
task: Identify mechanism of photoreceptor degeneration in NMNAT1-associated retinal disease
key_results: Oxidative DNA damage (8-oxo-dG accumulation) and caspase-9-mediated apoptosis drive photoreceptor loss; N-acetylcysteine treatment preserved cone photoreceptors and retinal function in vivo
comments: Strong mechanistic evidence linking a specific DNA adduct to cell death in a disease-relevant model, with a concrete therapeutic intervention showing structural and functional preservation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Reduced NMNAT1 function causes oxidative DNA damage leading to apoptosis-driven photoreceptor degeneration
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; NAC reduced DNA damage, apoptosis, and preserved PR structure and function

title: Inhibition of adipocyte RUNX1/2 enhances adipose tissue thermogenesis through distinct mechanisms
task: Establish RUNX1/2 as transcriptional regulators of thermogenic adipocyte differentiation
key_results: RUNX1/2 suppress thermogenic adipocyte programs; genetic deletion enhances beige fat formation; RUNX1 recruits HDAC1 for epigenetic silencing while RUNX2 uses phase separation; pharmacological inhibition improves thermogenesis
comments: Mechanistically sophisticated with distinct mechanisms for two paralogous proteins, though differential effects on systemic metabolism by RUNX1 vs. RUNX2 deletion suggest context-dependent physiology needing further exploration.

model_io.model: Adipocyte-specific RUNX1/RUNX2 knockout mice; primary adipocytes

hypotheses.hypothesis: RUNX1 and RUNX2 act as transcriptional barriers to thermogenesis through distinct epigenetic mechanisms
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; RUNX1 uses HDAC1-mediated silencing while RUNX2 uses phase separation-dependent repression; inhibition enhances thermogenesis

title: Differential cellulose distribution drives polarized growth of cotton fibers
task: Elucidate cellulose-dependent polarized cell wall remodeling in cotton fiber elongation
key_results: Basipetal gradient of cellulose microfibril density from apex to shank drives anisotropic growth; cellulose synthase complexes guided by microtubule organization; mechanical modeling confirms gradient-dependent directional strain
comments: Elegant single-cell system bridging cell biology, biophysics, and mechanics; however, the sufficiency of the cellulose gradient for sustained elongation versus additional regulatory factors (turgor, auxin signaling) remains to be dissected.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Basipetal cellulose gradient drives directed cotton fiber elongation through differential cell wall extensibility
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; cellulose density distribution correlates with anisotropic growth; mechanical model validates gradient sufficiency for directional strain

title: Anti-aging potential of Limosilactobacillus fermentum F-B9-1-2 extracellular vesicles in D-galactose–induced cellular and organ senescence
task: Assess anti-aging effects of probiotic-derived extracellular vesicles in senescence models
key_results: Lactobacillus fermentum EVs attenuated D-galactose-induced senescence in vitro; in vivo, improved locomotor activity and memory with downregulation of p16/p19/p21 and reduced inflammatory markers
comments: Comprehensive in vitro and in vivo characterization with relevant aging markers, but mechanistic specificity of EV components remains unclear and long-term efficacy needs validation.

model_io.model: D-galactose-induced aging in mice; HUVEC cells

hypotheses.hypothesis: Probiotic-derived EVs attenuate D-galactose-induced senescence via reduced inflammation and oxidative stress
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; LDEVs improved cellular viability and reduced aging-related markers in multiple tissues

title: Limosilactobacillus reuteri metabolites modulate immune pathways and intestinal barrier repair after 5 fluorouracil exposure
task: Assess probiotic metabolite effects on barrier repair and immune modulation after chemotherapy
key_results: L. reuteri exopolysaccharides enhanced barrier integrity in Caco-2 and primary intestinal epithelial cells post-5FU; modulated extracellular matrix genes and differential monocyte polarization
comments: Mechanistically detailed with transcriptomic validation, but the apparent paradox of inflammatory protein induction alongside barrier protection suggests context-dependent effects requiring further investigation.

model_io.model: Caco-2 intestinal epithelial cells; primary human intestinal epithelial cells; THP-1 monocytes

hypotheses.hypothesis: L. reuteri metabolites promote barrier recovery post-chemotherapy via extracellular matrix remodeling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; exopolysaccharides improved epithelial integrity and upregulated structural reorganization pathways

title: Adrenaline restores Bmal1 transcriptional rhythms dampened by SARS-CoV-2 infection in Cthrc1-positive pulmonary fibroblasts derived from the Nile grass rat
task: Determine role of circadian clock regulation in SARS-CoV-2-induced pulmonary pathology
key_results: SARS-CoV-2 infection suppressed Bmal1 transcription in Cthrc1+ pulmonary fibroblasts; adrenaline via β2-adrenoceptor restored and amplified Bmal1 rhythms within 4 days
comments: Novel link between viral infection and circadian disruption with a therapeutic lead, but the functional consequences of Bmal1 dampening on fibrotic progression remain speculative.

model_io.model: GrLBmal1-luc fibroblasts (Nile grass rat, ACE2-overexpressing); Bmal1-luciferase reporter

hypotheses.hypothesis: SARS-CoV-2 infection dampens Bmal1 transcriptional rhythms in pulmonary fibroblasts
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Bmal1 suppression observed post-infection with gradual recovery

hypotheses.hypothesis: Adrenaline restores Bmal1 rhythms via β2-adrenoceptor signaling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; adrenaline accelerates Bmal1 rhythm recovery post-infection

title: Sildenafil pretreatment attenuates apoptosis and intestinal injury in a hypoxia–ischemia–induced NEC-like rat model
task: Evaluate sildenafil-mediated protection against hypoxic-ischemic intestinal injury in NEC
key_results: Sildenafil pretreatment (10 mg/kg) reduced intestinal injury score dose-dependently (1.06 vs. 8.8 in NEC), decreased caspase-3 immunoreactivity, suppressed Bax/HIF-1α, and increased Bcl-2 (Bax/Bcl-2 ratio p<0.0001)
comments: Strong mechanistic and histological evidence linking nitric oxide-cGMP signaling to apoptosis suppression; excellent dose-response and molecular correlation, though mechanism of HIF-1α suppression by sildenafil remains incompletely defined.

inputs: Hypoxia (100% N₂, 60 s, twice daily 48 h) + cold stress (4°C, 10 min)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sildenafil (PDE-5 inhibitor) attenuates apoptosis in hypoxic-ischemic intestinal injury via nitric oxide-cGMP signaling and modulation of HIF-1α
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; dose-dependent reduction of injury and apoptotic markers with normalization of Bax/Bcl-2 ratio

title: PAK5 drives vascular remodeling in hypoxic pulmonary hypertension via Drp1-dependent mitochondrial midzone division
task: Elucidate PAK5-Drp1 pathway driving vascular remodeling in hypoxic pulmonary hypertension
key_results: Hypoxia upregulates PAK5, activating Drp1-mediated mitochondrial midzone fission, promoting PASMC proliferation; PAK5 silencing improved hemodynamics and reduced fission in vivo
comments: Clear link between mitochondrial dynamics and pathological cell proliferation with relevant in vivo validation, though the specificity of 'midzone division' and its distinction from typical fission warrants mechanistic detail.

model_io.model: Hypoxic pulmonary hypertension (HPH) mice; PASMCs in hypoxia

hypotheses.hypothesis: PAK5-mediated Drp1 activation drives mitochondrial fission and PASMC proliferation in HPH
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; PAK5 deficiency reduces fission and proliferative markers; improved hemodynamics in vivo

title: Curcumin nanocrystals mitigate hypoxia-induced cardiac injury through redox regulation and CHOP-CytC-caspase pathway modulation
task: Determine protective mechanisms of curcumin nanocrystals against hypoxic-ischemic cardiac injury
key_results: Curcumin nanocrystals reduced myocardial injury score (4.9 vs. 8.8 in untreated), apoptosis (3.6% vs. 10%), and ROS (18% reduction); modulated CHOP/CytC/caspase axis and restored Bcl-2
comments: Comprehensive multiscale analysis from tissue to molecular signaling with clear dose-response effects, though the short observation window and lack of chronic functional assessment limit translational impact assessment.

model_io.model: Piglet abdominal firearm injury under simulated high-altitude hypoxia

hypotheses.hypothesis: Curcumin nanocrystals protect cardiomyocytes from hypoxic-ischemic apoptosis via endoplasmic reticulum stress modulation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; reduced CHOP-driven mitochondrial apoptosis pathway and improved tissue integrity in dose-dependent manner

title: TWEAK-induced alternative NF-κB signaling regulates Cxcl10 and Mymx to promote myoblast-to-myotube fusion and muscle regeneration
task: Identify TWEAK-NF-κB axis regulating myoblast fusion and muscle regeneration
key_results: TWEAK activates alternative NF-κB (RelB) signaling to upregulate Mymx and Cxcl10; RelB directly binds Mymx and Cxcl10 promoters; TWEAK-deficient mice show impaired fusion
comments: Clean transcriptional mechanism with genetic validation and in vivo confirmation; the specific role of CXCL10 in fusion (traditionally an immune chemokine) is conceptually novel and warrants functional dissection.

model_io.model: C2C12 and primary mouse myoblasts; TWEAK-deficient mice

hypotheses.hypothesis: TWEAK activates alternative NF-κB signaling to promote myoblast fusion via Mymx and Cxcl10 upregulation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; RelB-mediated transcriptional activation of fusion genes; impaired fusion in TWEAK-deficient context

title: Polo-like kinase Cdc5 orchestrates Cdk1 regulation via Swe1 and Mih1 during meiotic prophase I exit
task: Define Cdc5-mediated regulation of Cdk1 at meiotic prophase I exit
key_results: Cdc5 promotes Cdk1 activation by inducing Swe1 degradation (CDK-priming independent) and facilitating Mih1 nuclear translocation; Swe1 required for checkpoint maintenance but not activation
comments: Mechanistic clarity on how conserved cell cycle kinases are repurposed for meiosis, though the functional significance of CDK-priming independence in meiosis versus mitosis deserves more discussion.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cdc5 drives meiosis I entry by promoting Swe1 degradation and Mih1 nuclear translocation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Cdc5 activity induces removal of Cdk1 inhibitory phosphorylation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Swe1 is required for meiotic checkpoint maintenance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Swe1 necessary for sustaining prophase I arrest but not checkpoint activation

title: Exonic enhancers are a widespread class of dual-function regulatory elements
task: Characterization of exonic enhancers as dual-function regulatory elements
key_results: Candidate exonic enhancers (cEEs) identified genome-wide; cEE mutations correlate with dysregulated target-gene expression; 28 variants across 12 genes affect cardiovascular and cancer genes
comments: Important conceptual expansion of regulatory element landscape, but functional validation limited to selected cEEs and disease impact requires larger clinical cohorts.

model_io.model: Multi-modal integration (TF binding + chromatin accessibility + enhancer-reporter assays)
